business_problem: ServiceNow needed a clearer skills roadmap and a faster way to map job families, identify workforce skill gaps, and guide reskilling and upskilling as AI changes roles and responsibilities.
solution_summary: ServiceNow worked with IBM Consulting to deploy ServiceNow Talent Development for an internal pilot covering selected job functions. The implementation enriched ServiceNow's out-of-the-box job and skills ontology with IBM Talent Frameworks and IBM skills taxonomy data so the platform could better model role-specific and industry-specific skills. ServiceNow's AI-powered skills intelligence engine then analyzed workforce capability information to detect gaps and recommend relevant training and growth opportunities in the flow of work. IBM Consulting also handled implementation and organizational change management, including integration with existing HR enterprise systems and processes. The result was a single-platform talent development workflow that combined skills data, AI-driven analysis, and rollout support for internal adoption.

data_flow: IBM Talent Frameworks and related skills taxonomy data are fed into ServiceNow Talent Development to enrich its job and skills ontology. The platform connects with existing HR enterprise systems and third-party data sources, where ServiceNow's AI-powered skills intelligence evaluates workforce capabilities, identifies gaps, and returns training and growth recommendations to HR leaders and employees inside the workflow.
business_outcome: For the ServiceNow pilot, the combined solution reduced the time required to build job family architectures for selected groups and supported the internal rollout of Talent Development with a tailored change management approach.
